parsed.explanation: The unit detects the front wheel of a road vehicle seen from the side or at an angle: the tire, rim and the wheel-arch region of cars, vans, buses, trucks and fire engines.
parsed.evidence: In all 20 top photos the red box sits on a front wheel or wheel well, across very different vehicle types, colors and even a grayscale photo. The random photos, none of which contain vehicles, all score low (1-3).

F1_s1.explanation: The unit responds to a dark, round, ring-shaped form with a lighter center that has radial spokes, sitting inside an arched cutout along the lower edge of a large, smooth, often brightly colored panel.

parsed.explanation: The unit responds to a dark, round, ring-shaped form with a lighter center that has radial spokes, sitting inside an arched cutout along the lower edge of a large, smooth, often brightly colored panel.
parsed.evidence: In all 20 top photos the red box lands on this same round dark ring with a radial center, framed by an arch at the bottom edge of a broad glossy surface, whatever the color or overall shape. The random photos lack this circular rim-in-arch structure and score 1-3.
parsed.missing_data: Photos that show the round spoked ring on its own, without the surrounding panel and arch, or round dark rings in very different settings, to test whether the arch context is required.
